newsitem.title: ROMANIA: Romania leu at 6,942 to dlr on March 14 - BNR.
newsitem.headline: Romania leu at 6,942 to dlr on March 14 - BNR.

text.p: Romania's central bank (BNR) said on Monday it had calculated the exchange rate of the leu at 6,942 to the dollar for March 14.

The rate, which is not compulsory for book-keeping operations or inter-bank deals, would be used by the finance ministry, customs authorities, prosecution, police as well as for statistical pursposes, a BNR statement said.
The rate was based on prices quoted by commercial banks operating on Romania's foreign exchange market, it said.
The BNR also said it would calculate the exchange rates of the leu on a daily basis but those rates would be made public only once a week.
Last month, the BNR gave up computing the so-called leu's reference rate which was a weighted average based on daily reports of market operators.
